title: Deckchair Care Welcome Café
venue: Gatley United Reformed Church, Elm Road, Gatley SK8 4LY
description: Deckchair Care's welcoming, dementia-friendly community café offers company, conversation and activities for older residents, carers and anyone who would enjoy some company. The listed sessions run 1pm–3pm. Dates are individually sourced; check with the organiser for any changes.

title: Memory Lane at Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church
venue: Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church, Ramillies Avenue, Cheadle Hulme SK8 7AL
cost: Free; advance discussion and registration required
description: A supportive group for people with dementia accompanied by their carers, with conversation, reminiscence and optional activities. This is not a walk-in event: contact the church office on 0161 485 1605 to discuss the group and registration before attending.

title: Knit & Natter at Stockroom
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Free Tuesday knitting and crochet social. Experienced crafters, beginners and anyone who just wants a natter are welcome; bring your own project. Drop in, no booking needed. Dates individually listed on Stockroom's current calendar.

title: Bramall Hall Decorated for Christmas: A Musical Celebration
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
description: Festive decorations inspired by Christmas music fill historic Bramall Hall. Suitable for all ages. Walk-up tickets from the Museum Visitor Centre; last entry 3.45pm. The organiser lists 11–15 November at 11am–4.30pm; check any subsequent dates separately.

title: Christmas Craft Night at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
cost: Free; booking required; ages 16 and over
description: A free Christmas craft evening inspired by Agatha Christie and her connection to Cheadle. Make festive cards and decorations with a mystery, literary and Art Deco twist. The session is for ages 16 and over; book a place before travelling.

seo.access: For ages 16 and over. Booking is required even though the event is free.
seo.meta_description: Free Christmas Craft Night at Cheadle Library on 12 November 2026, 5.30–7pm. Agatha Christie-themed crafts for ages 16+. Book ahead.
seo.search_title: Christmas Craft Night, Cheadle | 12 Nov 2026 | SK8 Scoop

title: Digital support drop-in at Bramhall Library
venue: Bramhall Library, 70 Bramhall Lane South, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 2DU
description: Stockport Libraries Digital Champions offer free help using phones, tablets, laptops and online services. Free drop-in 2pm–3pm; individual dates are shown in the current council events calendar.

title: Free Business Advice at Bramhall Library
venue: Bramhall Library, 70 Bramhall Lane South, Bramhall SK7 2DU
cost: Free; drop-in or book a one-hour adviser session
description: Meet advisers from the One Stockport Business Support Hub, GM Business Growth Hub, EnterprisingYou and Build a Business. Ask about business planning, funding, marketing, training or growth. Open to people considering a business and existing local operators.

title: Free Work and Skills Navigator drop-in at Bramhall Library
venue: Bramhall Library, 70 Bramhall Lane South, Bramhall SK7 2DU
description: Drop in for practical support with job hunting, CVs, applications, interviews, qualifications and career changes. The council calls this a monthly second-Thursday session; this listing is specifically for 12 November.

title: Journey to the Dark Side of the UNE
venue: Jodrell Bank, Bomish Lane, Lower Withington, Macclesfield SK11 9DW
description: UNE, the electronic dream-pop and ambient duo of Mark Radcliffe and Paul Langley, perform inside Jodrell Bank's Space Dome with full-dome visuals and a space conversation with Professor Tim O'Brien. Doors open at 7pm and the event runs 7:30pm to 10pm.

title: Oleanna at CHADS Theatre
venue: CHADS Theatre, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AU
description: CHADS presents David Mamet's thought-provoking two-character drama about a professor and student, authority and power. The studio is on the first floor, accessed by stairs, so check accessibility before booking.

title: Storytime at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
description: Free half-hour story and rhyme sessions for pre-school children and their parents or carers. Each of the listed 12, 19 and 26 November 2pm sessions is independently shown on Stockport Council's current events calendar. Check for any timetable changes before travelling.

title: Youth Night at Stockroom
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Free Thursday evening social, crafts, board games and creative projects for young people aged 14–25. Sessions are 5pm–7pm. Check the event page for the specific week's activities.

title: Storytime at Cheadle Hulme Library
venue: Cheadle Hulme Library, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme, Stockport SK8 5AU
description: Stories and rhymes for pre-school children and their parents or carers, with colouring sheets to take home. Sessions 2pm–2.30pm. Each of the listed Fridays is individually confirmed on the council calendar; check again for changes.

title: Bramhall Early Festive Market
venue: Village Square, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 1AW
description: A free early festive market with local makers, handmade decorations, gifts and food stalls. Worker Bee Markets also advertises face painting and children's activities; purchases and optional extras cost extra.

title: Cloud's Rainbow Flock: SEND-friendly family afternoon
venue: Brabyns Recreation Centre, Brabyns Park, Brabyns Brow, Marple Bridge, Stockport SK6 5DT
description: Free SEND-friendly creative family afternoon with a woolly trail, rainbow crafts, stories and sensory activities. Drop in between 11.30am and 2pm; children must be supervised by a responsible adult.

title: GO Wild: Pokémon GO Rocket Takeover
venue: Viaduct Park, Stockport Interchange, Stockport SK3 0EH
description: Free large-scale Pokémon GO community event with themed Team Rocket activities, raids and meet-ups around Stockport. Runs 9.30am–6pm; follow the organisers' instructions for participation.

title: Hannah Louise live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Female vocalist Hannah Louise performs on Saturday evening. The venue’s current diary lists an 8.45pm start, free entry for members and £5 for non-members.

title: Hat Works Factory Floor Tour
venue: Hat Works, Wellington Road South, Stockport SK3 0EU
cost: £8.50 adults; £7 concessions; under-16s free; fees may apply
description: Guided tour of Stockport's hat-making past, 10.30am–11.30am. Most suited to adults and children aged eight or older. Leisure Key holders and accompanying carers have free admission; online booking fee applies.

title: Seventy Years of Song: St George's Singers
venue: St Michael and All Angels Church, St Michael's Avenue, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 2PG
description: St George's Singers celebrate their 70th anniversary with choral music including Bach, Brahms, Elgar, Fauré, Handel and Rutter. The concert runs 7.30pm–9.30pm; see organiser booking details.

title: Storytime at Heald Green Library
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, Heald Green, Stockport SK8 3JB
description: Free half-hour story and rhyme session for pre-school children and their parents or carers. Council calendar confirms the listed November Saturdays. Check the council calendar for any changes.

title: Dance Night at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Sunday dance night with a DJ taking requests. The venue’s current events diary lists an 8pm start and £5 pay-on-the-door entry.

title: Stockport's Spectacular Sunday
venue: Merseyway, Underbanks, Market Place and other Stockport town-centre locations
cost: Free; food, shopping and travel extra
description: More than 200 performers and over 50 free street shows, including a giant Snow Lion, circus and live music. A drummers' parade leads to a 4.45pm Christmas lights switch-on. Check the organiser's programme for locations and access before travelling.

title: Brews & Boardgames at Stockroom
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Weekly free board games and conversation in Stockroom's Warm + Well programme. Games include chess, Jenga, Catan, Azul, Connect 4 and more. Sessions start 10am. Check the event page for updates.

title: The Upper Room Café drop-in
venue: The Upper Room, 11 Wilmslow Road, Cheadle SK8 1DW
cost: Free entry; refreshments available to buy
description: A relaxed, welcoming Cheadle drop-in with friendly company, guidance and support, including for people living with dementia. Free to enter; refreshments cost extra. The council lists the 16 November session from 11am to 1pm.

title: Stockport Climate and Nature Summit
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Free programme including toddler storytime, children's nature crafts and community workshops on health, growing and resilience. Individual sessions have different times; consult the organiser's programme and booking options before attending.

title: Lum Head nursery and reception open day
venue: Lum Head Primary School, Troutbeck Road, Gatley SK8 4RR
description: Families considering nursery or reception places for September 2027 can look around Lum Head Primary School and meet staff. The school asks visitors to book a tour by calling 0161 428 7992 or emailing its school office.

seo.access: Public open day for families considering nursery or reception in September 2027. Book a place with the school before visiting.
seo.meta_description: Visit Lum Head Primary School in Gatley on 19 November 2026, 2–3pm, to explore nursery and reception places for 2027. Free; book your tour.

title: Tarot Reading for Beginners at Stockroom
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: A playful beginner-friendly tarot workshop about card reading and reflection, rather than predicting the future. Free event starting at 5pm; see the organiser for attendance details.

title: Digital support drop-in at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
description: Free help with devices and basic online tasks from a friendly volunteer, aimed at beginners. Just turn up; no booking is needed. The organiser asks visitors to check library changes before travelling.

title: Liam Gallagher / Oasis tribute night
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Paul Hand performs a Liam Gallagher and Oasis tribute at the club, starting at 8.45pm. The venue's calendar says entry is free to members and £5 for non-members; check for changes before travelling.

title: Heald Green Christmas Market and Lights
venue: Car park behind 232–234 Finney Lane, Heald Green, SK8 3QA
description: Community Christmas market with stalls, entertainment and the local Christmas lights switch-on. Organised by Heald Green and Long Lane Ratepayers Association; check the organiser's programme closer to the day.

title: Sunday Qi Gong at Stockroom
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PW
description: Relaxed, low-impact Qi Gong with gentle flowing movements suitable for a range of abilities. Wear comfortable clothing; booking is available from the organiser. Please read the organiser's health guidance.

title: Jack and the Beanstalk at Heald Green Theatre
venue: Heald Green Theatre, Motcombe Grove (off Styal Road), Heald Green SK8 3TW
cost: Tickets on sale; check live booking page for current price
description: Heald Green Theatre’s annual pantomime runs Monday 30 November to Sunday 6 December. Monday to Friday performances are at 7.30pm; Saturday and Sunday have 1.30pm and 6.30pm shows. Tickets are on sale through the theatre’s booking route.

title: Special Christmas Storytime at Cheadle Hulme Library
venue: Cheadle Hulme Library, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme, Stockport SK8 5AJ
description: Extra festive stories and songs at the library, 2pm–2.30pm. A free family session listed by Stockport Libraries.

title: Special Christmas Storytime at Heald Green Library
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, Heald Green, Stockport SK8 3JB
description: A free festive storytime with songs and Christmas stories. Runs 11am–11.30am.
